exceptions.subject: ubuntu-24.04
exceptions.risk_reason: GitHub-hosted runner images are not exposed as digest-addressable artifacts; the fixed OS label still receives image updates.
exceptions.mitigation: The OS family is fixed, every external action and OCI image is digest-bound, Node is exact, and release jobs fail closed on their required tool versions. Re-reviewed on 2026-11-03: the last green main CI (run 40453614341, 2026-10-27) still ran image 20261012.334.1; the current official immutable inventory 20261026.354.1 (OS 24.04.5 LTS, kernel 7.0.0-1017-azure) still ships PostgreSQL client 16.15, which the replay job's exact psql gate accepts. Renewal only (42 days, inside the 45-day cap); the underlying condition, a mutable hosted-runner label, is unchanged; see docs/ci-runner-review-20261103.md.
